limitations: One seed and repeat; remote/local model generation may remain nondeterministic. Related authored suite variants and overlapping suites are not independent population samples.
Local policy covers original targets and per-call quantity, not cumulative constraints, prerequisite sequences, simulated approvals or changing/revoked intent.
Browser policy cannot inspect destinations hidden behind clicks. Native smoke cases do not establish full-benchmark effectiveness.
AgentDojo baseline attack probe did not succeed; browser tasks failed or timed out. These cases cannot establish prevented attack success.
SuiteCRM snapshot restoration covers its dedicated database for task47 only.
ST runtime intentionally overrides upstream Playwright pins with 1.64.0 for macOS compatibility; three dependency-pin incompatibilities remain documented.
